Food is spectacular!!!
Jan 2025 • Family
I’m not one for burgers, but I keep coming back (and ordering through their website for 10% discount) for the LEGEND BURGER. 

The meat is cooked medium: the pink juicy meat is then juxtaposed with crunchy fried onions and proper slices of crispy bacon with mature melted cheddar on top and enveloped in brioche. And every few bites you get a hit of jalapeño! True perfection! I don’t know what will replace this legend when I leave Viet Nam 😋

Wash it all down with a Pasteur Street Chang Muoi and you’ll be happy out! Great atmosphere on top of it all 😌

I’ve had two Sunday roasts here: all the trimmings are just as delicious as the roast meat, so it’s a real treat on a Sunday.

Always a Pleasant Experience at The Rabbit Hole
Jul 2022
I have visited The Rabbit Hole several times and, in general, I have had a very good experience with the meals I have ordered and always a warm welcome from the lovely owner Ian, and his friendly staff. Although I think they have now taken the satays off the menu, I have enjoyed the chicken satay with a salad many times, as the sauce is delightful, and their Sunday roasts. As I only really enjoy chicken Sunday roast, the staff and chef have always been kind enough to swop whatever their current roast is, with their succulent, crispy roast chicken. This comes with tasty potatoes and well cooked veg, and a very more-ish gravy. Their desserts are delicious too, particularly the passion fruit tart - I love the blend of a sharp and sweet dessert together - something seldom found in Ho Chi Minh as all of the desserts I have tried here have been super sweet without any balance of flavours. There was an occasion when we weren't happy with a chicken dish, and this was a rare once off occurrence, but in fairness we weren't charged for it, and we were offered an alternate meal, which we received and enjoyed. The pork ribs were very pleasant indeed, as were the piping hot french fries. There is a lovely relaxed ambience too and it is very pleasant to while away the hours here. We enjoy sitting outside,but there is a canopy that is drawn across the seating area to keep off the midday sun, and the most effective fans I have come across. The wine is a great price too - one of the cheapest set of prices in the city. The Sunday roast also includes a glass of wine, which makes it great value and there is an attractive happy hour. Although inexpensive, the Famingo rose wine is delicious, especially with lots of ice and a splash of soda. Altogether a very pleasant and relaxing experience.

Recommended
Jun 2022
Here on three occasions while on my travels in HCMC.

Enjoyed every time, good fun, very friendly staff and great place to spend a (good) few hours.

Good they have Bulmers on tap (Magners) and can get an Irish breakfast. Pity they don't have Guinness, but they have a half decent alternative in Pasteur Street Stout. 

First time round, after watching some Bog ball (gaa football) on the tele, decided to try some pool with the regulars........which was great fun.......

Other two times, came for the Irish breakfast with friends, and the food was great, a massive portion and very filling. Great!

Also played the shuffleboard for the first time with friend, and we both played it for hours, competitive as we were....

The staff are excellent, chatty and friendly and very competent. Top staff like that are hard to find. Credit to the owner for catching them........

Only slightly negative, some of the pictures are a bit dated......and it is a bit pricey

Overall, a top bar, and well worth a visit, or two..........when in HCMC

Sunday Brunch at The Rabbit Hole
Jul 2022 • Family
Hey everyone, hope you are all having a great Sunday. 😊

I‘m normal not very active in writing reviews, but this afternoon me and the family went to The Rabbit Hole Irish Sports Bar (Ho Chi Minh) for a Sunday roast brunch which really blew us away and just had to share our experience with you. 

We ordered the pork roast and 2 steaks with Phu Quốc pepper sauce and a chef’s special sauce with fries, mash, salad and crunchy greens. If you are looking for a proper home cooked meal to enjoy with family and friends in a smoke free place, I highly recommend you give this a try! 

Thank you very much Ian and Hoa for the great hospitality! Definitely coming back for more. 😅🍻
